Q234.sql: SELECT n1.n_name AS supp_nation, n2.n_name AS cust_nation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l_shipdate) AS l_year, l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) AS volume, l_shipdate, n1.n_name, n2.n_name FROM supplier , lineitem , orders , customer , nation AS n1 , nation AS n2 WHERE s_suppkey = l_suppkey AND o_orderkey = l_orderkey AND c_custkey = o_custkey AND s_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey AND c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey AND ((n1.n_name = 'UNITED STATES' AND n2.n_name = 'PERU') OR (n1.n_name = 'PERU' AND n2.n_name = 'UNITED STATES')) AND l_shipdate BETWEEN CAST('1992-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('1992-12-31' AS DATE)

		from (
		select n1.n_name as supp_nation, n2.n_name as cust_nation,
				extract(year from l_shipdate) as l_year,
				l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as volume
		from supplier, lineitem, orders, customer, nation n1, nation n2
		where
			s_suppkey = l_suppkey
			and o_orderkey = l_orderkey
			and c_custkey = o_custkey
			and s_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey
			and c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey

			and l_shipdate between date '1992-01-01' and date '1992-12-31'

		order by supp_nation, cust_nation, l_year;
